roadmap.out_of_scope: No sleeps or larger timeouts as the fix. No change to serve's pass logic, exit codes, or summary shape. No push: commit locally until the user says push.

phases.name: Correlate each trigger with its own pass summary

steps.name: trigger reports the pass_id it completed
steps.description: control.rs: TriggerOutcome::Completed carries pass_id (trigger_outcome_of keeps it instead of discarding it at :121). report() prints {"event":"indexer.trigger.completed","pass_id":...,"exit_code":...} on stdout for a completed pass. Exit codes are unchanged; coalesced and unreachable outputs are unchanged. Update the existing proptests (around :368 and :444) and add the new event to docs/architecture/indexer-deployment/data-models.md (event table near :95), plus a short dated note in ADR-080.
criteria: A completed trigger prints exactly one indexer.trigger.completed line whose pass_id and exit_code equal the reply's
Trigger exit codes are unchanged for completed, coalesced and unreachable
The event's fields are within STRUCTURAL_EVENT_FIELDS (the event-field guard at indexer_live.rs:907 still passes)

steps.name: Harness waits for the summary of the pass it triggered
steps.description: tests/acceptance/support/indexer_live.rs: assert_one_summary_matching (and given_a_pass_indexed, and any helper that reads summaries right after a trigger) takes the pass_id from the trigger's indexer.trigger.completed line. It waits on the collected lines (up to TRIGGER_CEILING; condvar or short poll on the collector, never a fixed sleep) until a summary with that pass_id exists. It then asserts exactly one summary for that pass_id and that its exit_code equals the trigger's. Coalesced and unreachable triggers do not wait. Regression proof: add a test-only way to slow the stdout line collector (e.g. a per-line delay in spawn_line_collector set by a LiveIndex builder option or a harness env var such as OPENLORE_TEST_COLLECTOR_LAG_MS). Add one acceptance test in indexer_deployment_did_list.rs that runs the purge-fails scenario (exit 0, then 2, then 0) with a 150 ms lag. It must fail on the current harness and pass after the fix. Any event read right after a trigger in did_list (:139, :414, :555, :581, :644) happens after the summary has been awaited.
criteria: The lagged regression test fails before the harness change (record the RED) and passes after
All indexer_deployment_* acceptance tests pass, and still pass with OPENLORE_TEST_COLLECTOR_LAG_MS=150 (or the equivalent knob) applied to the whole binary
No assertion is removed or weakened; exit-code and one-summary-per-pass checks stay
steps.scenario_name: a lagged summary stream still checks the triggered pass's own summary (new regression)
steps.test_command: cargo nextest run -p cli --test indexer_deployment_did_list --test indexer_deployment_passes --test indexer_deployment_public_surface --test indexer_deployment_walking_skeleton
